name: asfai-learning
description: Teach and plan with ASFAI, use Pod-first private storage, and exchange work with classroom providers through one remote MCP connector.

interface.shortDescription: ASFAI learning, private data, and classroom exchange.
interface.longDescription: Create and run lessons through chat, use the ASFAI learning graph, connect PrivateDataPod and other Solid Pods, and exchange work with configurable classroom providers through one authenticated remote MCP connector. A connected Pod is the primary learning-record store. Pod and Google Classroom authorization is encrypted, isolated to the user's connector, and restored across devices using that connection until explicit removal or provider revocation.
defaultPrompt: Connect my private Pod and continue my lesson.
Help me learn a concept and save my progress.
Create a lesson or import classroom work and evaluate it.
